limits: killpg PermissionError may mask original executor/command failure; successful publication is not claimed
command Popen context/wait can remain blocked if cleanup cannot terminate leader; no strict all-OS-state deadline guarantee
read-only probe.close and Leases.close do not universally preserve earlier errors
CodexExecutor deadline starts after stdin writes, so blocked input is not covered
escaped sessions, PID/PGID reuse and orphan reaping are unproved
manual liveness confirmation and synthetic receipts are not autonomous formal-agent recovery
